text: This application proposes to redevelop the site at 363-391 Yonge Street and 3 Gerrard Street East with a 98 storey tower and 9-storey podium. The project is proposed to contain 957 dwelling units and 20,516 square metres of office and retail space. The total gross floor area would be 97,386 square metres. The proposal includes 5 levels of underground parking containing 340 parking spaces and 1 additional below grade level for retail/bicycle parking uses. The purpose of this report is to seek further instructions for a Local Planning Appeal Tribunal ("LPAT") pre-hearing conference which is scheduled for August 20, 2018. City Planning has been involved in the preparation of this report.

City Council on June 26, 27, 28 and 29, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 18, 2018) from the City Solicitor, as amended by Part 2 below. 2. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the supplementary report (June 25, 2018) from the City Solicitor. 3. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1, as amended, and Confidential Appendices B and C to the report (June 18, 2018) from the City Solicitor and City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Appendix A to the report (June 18, 2018) from the City Solicitor remain confidential. 4.
